name: card-swipe
title: Card swipe
description: Cards that turn away like pages when you swipe, drag or use the arrows.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the carousel, read by screen readers. Default “Cards”.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the previous button. Default “Previous”.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the next button. Default “Next”.

props.name: labels
props.description: Words for slide names and the position announcement, e.g. “Card 2 of 5”. Keys: `slide`, `of`.

a11y.text: The carousel takes focus with Tab and shows a focus ring. Arrow keys step through the cards while focus is on the carousel or on a button inside it. The previous and next buttons are disabled at the ends. A drag moves on past 50 px or a velocity of 500.

The section is a carousel labelled by label (default "Cards"). Each card is a slide group named like "Card 2 of 5", set through labels. Cards that are not current are aria-hidden and inert. A status region that stays in the page reads the new position after each step. The buttons are named by previousLabel and nextLabel; the icons and dots are aria-hidden.
The slide movement uses Motion with reduced motion set to user.
